name: scroll-images-reveal-003
title: Scroll Images Reveal 003
description: A scrolling stack of sticky, nearly full-height image cards. Each card pins near the top, and as you scroll past it rotates, shrinks and fades out while the next one takes over.
use: A long visual story or portfolio needs full-height photos that hold attention as the page scrolls.
avoid: Each card is about 80vh tall and the stack runs for many screens, so it is unsuited to short pages.
a11y: There is no reduced-motion handling, and each image's alt text is its raw URL, so photos have no useful description. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A column of wide rounded rectangles, each almost a full screen tall and filled edge to edge with a photo cropped to cover. They sit down the page with large gaps, and a small uppercase hint for scrolling sits near the top.
behaves: Each card sticks below the top edge once it reaches it. Scrolling further rotates and scales it toward nothing while the photo inside counter-rotates, and the following card comes up underneath.
customise: Only the images array is a prop; card height, scroll distance, margin and the spin and shrink mapping are constants in the file.
weight: moderate: Seven sticky cards track scroll with motion values under a smooth-scroll wrapper.
demo: Seven Unsplash landscape photos and the hint 'scroll down to see effect'.
issues: No reduced-motion path: the shrink-and-spin scroll effect runs regardless of the user preference.
Image alt text is the raw URL, which tells screen reader users nothing about the photo.
polishWhy: No frames to judge; the code is a tidy, conventional sticky-stack effect.
